Method of Attack: Remote code execution via unauthenticated access to Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI)
Execution of arbitrary system commands, creation or deletion of files, disabling services, execution of arbitrary Java code
Exfiltration of user credentials and traversal of internal network
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated or authenticated network access to TMUI through BIG-IP management port and/or Self IPs
Indicators of Compromise: GitHub repository with PoCs to display /etc/passwd and device configuration files
Remote attacks observed by NCC Group
